cards.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna

attacks.name: Multiply
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Kakuna and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Sudden Sting
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Kakuna during this turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Cacnea

attacks.name: Sucker Punch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached to it, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.

cards.name: Cacturne

attacks.name: Spike Rend
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Hunt
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

cards.name: Karrablast

abilities.name: Shell On
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Shelmet from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

cards.name: Shelmet

attacks.name: Absorb
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

cards.name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it.

cards.flavorText: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

cards.name: Skiddo
cards.flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

cards.name: Gogoat

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 80 more damage to your opponent's Grass Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Horn Leech
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Dance of Flames
attacks.text: For each Energy attached to your opponent's Pokémon, attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Burning Bonemerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 70 damage for each heads. If either of them is heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: The bones it possesses were once its mother's. Its mother's regrets have become like a vengeful spirit protecting this Pokémon.

cards.name: Numel

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

cards.name: Camerupt

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Staryu
cards.flavorText: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.

cards.name: Starmie

abilities.name: Escape
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.

cards.name: Magikarp

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

attacks.name: Waterfall Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Gyarados-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Draconic Disaster
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 100 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.

attacks.name: Dread Storm-GX
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Swinub
cards.flavorText: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

cards.name: Piloswine

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep. Heal 90 damage from it.

cards.flavorText: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.

cards.name: Mamoswine

attacks.name: Double Stomp
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Forceful Tackle
attacks.text: You may put up to 9 damage counters on this Pokémon. This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter you placed in this way.

cards.flavorText: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

cards.name: Octillery

attacks.name: Ink Spit
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Special Artillery
attacks.text: You may discard a Special Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.flavorText: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.

cards.name: Crawdaunt

attacks.name: Double Claws
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

cards.name: Feebas

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.

cards.name: Milotic

attacks.name: TLC
attacks.text: Shuffle 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it and all cards attached to it into their deck.

attacks.name: Ocean Cyclone
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

cards.name: Regice

abilities.name: Iceberg Shield
abilities.text: If you have Regirock in play, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's Stage 2 Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.

cards.name: Shellos

attacks.name: Regeneration
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Pika Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Alolan Raichu

abilities.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler

attacks.name: Self-Destruct
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

cards.name: Alolan Golem-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Super Electromagnetic Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Heavy Rock-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Energy Catch
attacks.text: Put 3 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Volt Switch
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Lightning Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

cards.name: Gastly

attacks.name: Ominous Eyes
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

cards.name: Haunter

attacks.name: Pain Amplifier
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.flavorText: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.

cards.name: Gengar

abilities.name: Gnawing Curse
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fade to Black
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.

cards.name: Misdreavus

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It will use any means necessary to frighten people and absorb their life energy. It practices constantly to hone its skill in causing fear.

cards.name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Chaos Wheel
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Pokémon Tool, Special Energy, or Stadium cards from their hand during their next turn.

attacks.name: Dark Arts
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each card in your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: It appears as if from nowhere—muttering incantations, placing curses, and giving people terrifying visions.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

cards.name: Grumpig

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Confused.

attacks.name: Psych Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psych Up attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

cards.name: Chimecho

attacks.name: Bell of Silence
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Pokémon that has an Ability from their hand during their next turn.

cards.flavorText: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

cards.flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

cards.name: Gourgeist

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Pumpkin Bomb
attacks.text: Before doing damage, you may discard any number of Pokémon Tool cards from your Pokémon. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

cards.name: Salandit

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

cards.name: Oranguru

attacks.name: Fixer of the Forest
attacks.text: Put 3 Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

cards.name: Nihilego-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Empty Light
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may leave both Active Pokémon Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Lock Up
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Symbiont-GX
attacks.text: Add the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck to their Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Three-Step Strike
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Lucha Fight
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It has been known to become so angry that it dies as a result. Its face looks peaceful in death, however.

cards.name: Cubone

attacks.name: Leer
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: When it thinks of its deceased mother, it weeps loudly. Mandibuzz that hear its cries will attack it from the air.

cards.name: Regirock

abilities.name: Rock Peak Growl
abilities.text: Your Registeel's attacks do 10 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Tough Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

cards.name: Gastrodon

attacks.name: Eerie Fluid
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has strong regenerative capabilities. Even if parts of it are bitten off by fish Pokémon, it will return to normal within a few hours.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear

abilities.name: Fluffy
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from the attacks of your opponent's non-Fire Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Cross-Cut
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Buzzwole-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Jet Punch
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Knuckle Impact
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Absorption-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each of your remaining Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: Around dawn, its ominous howl echoes through the area to announce that this is its territory.

cards.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Puncturing Fangs
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

cards.name: Deino

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

cards.name: Zweilous

attacks.name: Double Hit
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

cards.name: Hydreigon

abilities.name: Weed Out
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose 3 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, discard your other Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dark Destruction
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

cards.name: Guzzlord-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Eat Sloppily
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Glutton-GX
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 2 more Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Guzzlord-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Eat Sloppily
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Glutton-GX
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 2 more Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

cards.name: Aron
cards.flavorText: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.flavorText: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

cards.name: Aggron

attacks.name: Revenge Cannon
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on all of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Buster Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.

cards.name: Registeel

attacks.name: Turbo Arm
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Iron Hand
attacks.text: If Regice is on your Bench, heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

cards.name: Escavalier

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Iron Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

cards.name: Kartana-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Slice Off
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gale Blade
attacks.text: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Blade-GX
attacks.text: Take a Prize card. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It hugely inflates its stomach and sings a mysterious melody. If you hear this melody, you'll become sleepy right away.

cards.name: Wigglytuff

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Punishing Slap
attacks.text: If any of your opponent's Pokémon have any Darkness Energy attached to them, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.

cards.name: Xerneas

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Bright Horns
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Bright Horns during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Tropical Head
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Dragon Hammer
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Tower-Go-Round-GX

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

cards.name: Hakamo-o

attacks.name: Noble Roar

cards.flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

cards.flavorText: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

cards.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Sitdown Splash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank's.

cards.name: Swablu
cards.flavorText: For some reason, it likes to land on people's heads softly and act like it's a hat.

cards.name: Altaria

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

cards.name: Starly

attacks.name: Bug Search
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

cards.flavorText: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.flavorText: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

cards.name: Staraptor

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Sky Hunting
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by the damage from this attack, switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

cards.name: Regigigas

abilities.name: Seal of Antiquity
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't attack unless Regirock, Regice, and Registeel are on your Bench.

attacks.name: Giant Stomp
attacks.text: Discard any Stadium card in play.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

cards.flavorText: Minccino greet each other by grooming one another thoroughly with their tails.

cards.name: Cinccino

attacks.name: Amazing Plea
attacks.text: Choose 2 cards from your discard pile. Then, ask your opponent if you may put them into your hand. If yes, put those cards into your hand. If no, this attack does 80 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Diggersby

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

cards.flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.flavorText: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

cards.name: Grubbin
cards.flavorText: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Litten
cards.flavorText: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Cosmog

attacks.name: Dust Gathering
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.

cards.name: Alolan Diglett

attacks.name: Spelunk
attacks.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

cards.flavorText: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

cards.name: Cutiefly

attacks.name: Fly Around
attacks.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

cards.flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

cards.name: Pikipek

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.

cards.name: Yungoos
cards.flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Continuous Eggsplosion
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its six eggs use telepathy to communicate among themselves. It is believed to carry plant genes and the genes of other species.

cards.name: Yanma

attacks.name: Super Speed
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Yanmega

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Roselia

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. This Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

cards.name: Roserade

attacks.name: Inviting Poison
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. The new Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Flower Tornado
attacks.text: Move any number of Grass Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

cards.name: Turtwig

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Turtwig
cards.flavorText: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

cards.name: Grotle

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

cards.name: Torterra

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Cherubi

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

cards.name: Cherrim

abilities.name: Weather Guard
abilities.text: Your Grass Pokémon have no Weakness.

cards.flavorText: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Chomp Chomp
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Loom Over
attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Shaymin

attacks.name: Coax

attacks.name: Soothing Scent
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Dewpider

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid

abilities.name: Water Bubble
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Fire Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Magmar

attacks.name: Controlled Burn
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn't calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.

cards.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Fire Blaster
attacks.text: You may discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: From its arm, it launches fireballs hotter than 3,500 degrees Fahrenheit. Its arm starts to melt when it fires a whole barrage.

cards.name: Chimchar
cards.flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Chimchar

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

cards.name: Monferno

attacks.name: Super Singe

cards.flavorText: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

attacks.name: Burst Punch
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

cards.name: Heat Rotom

abilities.name: Roto Motor
abilities.text: If you have 9 or more Pokémon Tool cards in your discard pile, ignore all Energy in the attack cost of each of this Pokémon's attacks.

cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.flavorText: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokémon, then attacks them.

cards.name: Salazzle

attacks.name: Panic Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Confused, and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Hunter's Nails
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.

cards.name: Turtonator

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Signs of Evolution
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Dratini, a Dragonair, and a Dragonite, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Bind Wound
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The eggs laid by Chansey are rich in nutrients and a favorite food of many Pokémon.

cards.name: Eevee

abilities.name: Energy Evolution
abilities.text: When you attach a basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon that is the same type as that Energy card and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Quick Draw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.

cards.flavorText: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.

cards.name: Porygon

attacks.name: Code Check
attacks.text: Look at 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards.

cards.flavorText: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

cards.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

cards.name: Tangrowth

attacks.name: Hefty Whip
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was healed during this turn, this attack does 130 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

cards.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Fury Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If 1 of them is heads, this attack does 20 more damage. If 2 of them are heads, this attack does 50 more damage. If all of them are heads, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: While young, they live together deep in the mountains, training themselves in how to fight with their scythes and move at high speeds.

cards.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Grip and Squeeze
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.

cards.name: Chikorita

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Chikorita

attacks.name: Mini Drain
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

cards.name: Bayleef

attacks.name: Soothing Scent
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

cards.name: Meganium

abilities.name: Quick-Ripening Herb
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this Ability. Choose 1 of your Basic Pokémon in play. If you have a Stage 2 card in your hand that evolves from that Pokémon, put that card onto the Basic Pokémon to evolve it. You can use this Ability during your first turn or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn.

cards.flavorText: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

cards.name: Spinarak

attacks.name: Spider Scram
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned. Put this Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: Some fishermen weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.

cards.name: Ariados

attacks.name: Trapping Thread
attacks.text: Whenever your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand during their next turn, prevent all effects of that card done to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It spins thread from both its rear and its mouth. Then it wraps its prey up in thread and sips their bodily fluids at its leisure.

cards.name: Hoppip

attacks.name: Multiply
attacks.text: Search your deck for Hoppip and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Hoppip
cards.flavorText: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

cards.name: Skiploom

abilities.name: Floral Path to the Sky
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for Jumpluff, put this Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone, and put that Jumpluff in its place. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

cards.name: Jumpluff

attacks.name: Lost March
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon, except ◇ (Prism Star) Pokémon, in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

cards.name: Pineco

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

cards.name: Shuckle

abilities.name: Fresh Squeezed
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Energy Drink
attacks.text: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Shuckle-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Protective Shell
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have 2 or fewer Energy attached to them.

attacks.name: Triple Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 3 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Wrap-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Powerful Friends
attacks.text: If you have any Stage 2 Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

cards.name: Celebi ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

attacks.name: Time Distortion
attacks.text: Devolve any number of your Benched Pokémon as many times as you like. Put each Evolution card removed this way into your hand.

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Treecko

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

cards.name: Grovyle

abilities.name: Sunshine Grace
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

cards.name: Sceptile-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mach Cut
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Leaf Cyclone
attacks.text: Move a Grass Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Jungle Heal-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from each of your Pokémon that has any Grass Energy attached to it. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Wurmple
cards.flavorText: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Wurmple

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

cards.name: Silcoon

attacks.name: Cocoon Collector
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 4 in any combination of Silcoon and Cascoon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

cards.name: Beautifly

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Butterfly Edge
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Cascoon

attacks.name: Cocoon Collector
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 4 in any combination of Silcoon and Cascoon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

cards.name: Dustox

abilities.name: Hazardous Evolution
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Paralyzed and Poisoned. If you do, put 3 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

cards.name: Nincada

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

cards.name: Ninjask

abilities.name: Molting
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put a Shedinja from your discard pile onto your Bench.

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

cards.name: Combee

attacks.name: Bee March
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Combee and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

cards.name: Vespiquen

attacks.name: Commanding Queen
attacks.text: If you have 4 or fewer Grass Pokémon on your Bench, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

cards.name: Shaymin

abilities.name: Floral Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 20 damage from your Active Grass Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Virizion-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Double Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Sensitive Blade
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

attacks.name: Breeze Away-GX
attacks.text: Put any number of your Pokémon in play and all cards attached to them into your hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Skiddo

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

cards.name: Gogoat

attacks.name: Leaf Wallop
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Leaf Wallop attack does 50 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

cards.name: Tapu Bulu

attacks.name: Heavy Punch
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The guardian deity of Ula'ula is a lazy Pokémon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes and then deals them a savage blow with its horns.

cards.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Assisting Heater
attacks.text: You may attach a Fire Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Cyndaquil

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

cards.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Quilava

attacks.name: Super Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

cards.name: Typhlosion

abilities.name: Blazing Energy
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may use this Ability. All Energy attached to your Pokémon are Fire Energy instead of their usual type until the end of your turn. (This includes cards that come into play on this turn.)

attacks.name: Lost Flame
attacks.text: Put 2 Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

cards.name: Slugma

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

cards.name: Magcargo-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Crushing Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard the top card of your deck. If it's a basic Energy card, attach it to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lava Flow
attacks.text: Discard any amount of basic Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Burning Magma-GX
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Houndour

attacks.name: Team Hunt
attacks.text: Draw a card for each of your Houndour in play.

cards.flavorText: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

cards.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Attack Operation
attacks.text: If you have more cards in your hand than your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

cards.name: Entei

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Eruption
attacks.text: Each player discards the top card of their deck. This attack does 60 more damage for each Energy card discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Heatran

attacks.name: Lava Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Heat Bazooka
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

cards.flavorText: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Victini

attacks.name: V-Beatdown
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Basic Pokémon in play.

cards.flavorText: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

cards.name: Litleo

abilities.name: Wild Dash
abilities.text: If your opponent has any Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

cards.name: Pyroar

attacks.name: Crunch
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

cards.name: Blacephalon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Bursting Burn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.

attacks.name: Mind Blown
attacks.text: Put any amount of Fire Energy attached to your Pokémon in the Lost Zone. This attack does 50 damage for each card put in the Lost Zone in this way.

attacks.name: Burst-GX
attacks.text: Discard 1 of your Prize cards. If it's an Energy card, attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix

abilities.name: Secret Alleyway
abilities.text: If you have any Fairy Pokémon in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

cards.name: Slowpoke

attacks.name: Yawn
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.

cards.name: Slowking

attacks.name: Memory Melt
attacks.text: Look at your opponent's hand and put a card you find there in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is so famed for its intellect that a proverb still persists in some regions: "When in doubt, ask Slowking."

cards.name: Lapras

abilities.name: Go for a Swim
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

attacks.name: Ice Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

cards.name: Delibird

attacks.name: Happy Delivery
attacks.text: Choose any number of your Benched Pokémon that don't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to them. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.

cards.name: Mantine

abilities.name: Mantine Surf
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached to it, it has no Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

cards.name: Suicune

abilities.name: Frozen Flow
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aurora Gain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Suicune-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Phantom Winds
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may shuffle it and all cards attached to it into your deck.

attacks.name: Cure Stream
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Brinicles-GX
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Cubchoo

attacks.name: Secondary Chills
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only on your first turn. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

cards.name: Beartic

attacks.name: Resolute Claws
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon-GX or a Pokémon-EX, this attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blizzard Burn
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

cards.name: White Kyurem

attacks.name: Field Crush
attacks.text: If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Freezing Flames
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Fire Energy attached to it, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Popplio

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Popplio

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can control water bubbles. It practice diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

cards.name: Brionne

attacks.name: Captivate
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.

cards.name: Primarina

abilities.name: Harmonics
abilities.text: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, except with an attack, Ability, or Trainer card, attach up to 2 Energy cards to that Pokémon instead of 1.

attacks.name: Hypno Splash
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokémon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.

cards.name: Mareanie

attacks.name: Spike Cannon
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Toxapex

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venom Fever
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 50 damage for each damage counter on that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

cards.name: Bruxish

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Follow the Wound
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

cards.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Electricity leaks from it in amounts far greater than the amount of electricity it eats.

cards.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Electrocharge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: High-Voltage Knuckle
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it gets excited, it thumps its chest. With every thud, thunder roars and electric sparks shower all around.

cards.name: Chinchou

attacks.name: Thunder Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It lives in the depths beyond the reach of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Salvage
attacks.text: Shuffle 4 Item cards from your discard pile into your deck.

attacks.name: Signal Beam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Mareep

abilities.name: Fluffy Pillow
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Mareep

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Signal Beam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ampharos

abilities.name: Unseen Flash
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 Lightning Energy cards from your hand in the Lost Zone. If you do, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Split Bomb
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Raikou

attacks.name: Lost Voltage
attacks.text: If you have any Lightning Energy cards in the Lost Zone, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Overshort
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tool cards from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If you discarded a Pokémon Tool card in this way, this attack does 40 more damage, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard your hand and draw 4 cards.

cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Stunfisk

attacks.name: Flail
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Blast
attacks.text: Discard a Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

cards.name: Xatu

cards.flavorText: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

cards.flavorText: It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb grows dull and dark.

cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.flavorText: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it live quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Girafarig

attacks.name: Get Lost
attacks.text: Put 2 cards from your opponent's discard pile in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Mind Shock
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

cards.name: Shedinja

abilities.name: Vessel of Life
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard all cards attached to this Pokémon and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon as a Pokémon Tool card. When the Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 1 fewer Prize card.

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

cards.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Quick Hunt
attacks.text: If you go first, you can use this attack on your first turn. Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

cards.name: Giratina

abilities.name: Distortion Door
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. If you do, put 1 damage counter on 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shadow Impact
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

cards.name: Sigilyph-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Mirror Counter
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an attack from your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon equal to the damage done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sonic Wing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Intercept-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Yamask

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

cards.name: Cofagrigus

attacks.name: Spirit Juggling
attacks.text: Discard any number of your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 more damage for each Benched Pokémon you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies.

cards.name: Litwick

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

cards.name: Lampent

attacks.name: Haunt
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

cards.name: Chandelure

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Vortex of Pain
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on all of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

cards.name: Meloetta

attacks.name: Sing
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Miracle Harmony
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play that has the Sing attack. This attack does 10 damage for each heads to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feels of those who hear it.

cards.name: Mareanie

attacks.name: Pin Missile
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

cards.name: Nihilego

attacks.name: Nightcap
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if your opponent has exactly 2 Prize cards remaining. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Void Tentacles
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: One of the Ultra Beasts, it's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

cards.name: Poipole

attacks.name: Eye Opener
attacks.text: Look at your face-down Prize cards.

cards.flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

cards.name: Naganadel

abilities.name: Charging Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Turning Point
attacks.text: If you have exactly 3 Prize cards remaining, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

cards.name: Onix
cards.flavorText: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

cards.name: Sudowoodo

attacks.name: Reply Strongly
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn while it was your Active Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Apparently, the larger the green parts of this Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It's a particular favorite among elderly people.

cards.name: Phanpy

attacks.name: Last Resort
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

cards.name: Donphan

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, this Pokémon is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10.

attacks.name: Rolling Spin
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Rolling Spin attack does 70 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

cards.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Rapid Spin
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Triple Kick
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you'd like.

cards.name: Larvitar

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Second Strike
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has 3 or more damage counters on it, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar

abilities.name: Hard Shell Evolution
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by your opponent's attacks until the end of your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Carbink

attacks.name: Diamond Gate
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card and a Stadium card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Spoil the Fun
attacks.text: If you go second, this attack does 60 more damage during your first turn.

cards.flavorText: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

cards.name: Alolan Persian

attacks.name: Empty Threat
attacks.text: This attack does 30 less damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It looks down on everyone other than itself. Its preferred tactics are sucker punches and blindside attacks.

cards.name: Umbreon

attacks.name: Retaliate

cards.flavorText: With its black fur, it blends into the darkness. It bides its time, and when prey appears, this Pokémon goes for its threat, and then eats it.

cards.name: Steelix

cards.flavorText: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

cards.name: Scizor

abilities.name: Exoskeleton
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Special Blow
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Special Energy attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Once it has identified an enemy, this Pokémon smashes it mercilessly with pincers hard as steel.

cards.name: Dialga

cards.flavorText: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

cards.name: Cobalion

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

attacks.name: Energy Press
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sublimation-GX

cards.name: Marill

cards.name: Azumarill

attacks.text: Look at the top 8 cards of your deck and attach any number of Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

cards.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Make a Mess
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 Trainer cards from your hand. This attack does 20 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.

cards.name: Granbull

attacks.name: All Out
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 130 more damage.

cards.flavorText: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.

cards.name: Ralts

attacks.name: Beckon
