cards.flavorText: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

cards.name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Disarming Voice
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It has a psychic power that enabled it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

cards.name: Gardevoir

attacks.name: Brilliant Search
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Sensitive Ray
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

cards.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Zzzap Touch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses, and then it fires the electricity from its whiskers.

cards.name: Carbink

attacks.name: Wonder Ray
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by any Pokémon that has an Ability.

cards.flavorText: Although this Pokémon is not especially rare, its glittering, jewel-draped body draws attention from people.

attacks.name: Bright Horns
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Bright Horns during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

cards.name: Cutiefly

attacks.name: Sweet Scent
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.

cards.name: Ribombee

abilities.name: Mysterious Buzz
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to your Fairy Pokémon in play.

cards.flavorText: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

cards.name: Morelull

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

cards.name: Shiinotic

abilities.name: Effect Spore
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), the Attacking Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dream's Touch
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, your opponent shuffles all Energy from it into their deck.

cards.flavorText: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokémon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.

cards.name: Mimikyu-GX

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Let's Snuggle & Fall
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dream Fear-GX
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. Your opponent shuffles that Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Tapu Lele

abilities.name: Charmed Charm
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Pokémon Tool card that has "Fairy Charm" in its name from your hand to this Pokémon during your turn, you may leave your opponent's Active Pokémon Confused.

cards.flavorText: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.

cards.name: Tapu Fini

attacks.name: Dream Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent shuffles their Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into their deck.

attacks.name: Wonder Shine
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.

cards.name: Chansey

attacks.name: Healing Pirouette
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sympathetic Slap
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it before this attack does damage, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Not only are these Pokémon fast runners, they're also few in number, so anyone who finds one must be lucky indeed.

cards.name: Blissey

abilities.name: Happiness Supplement

attacks.name: Powerful Slap
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its fluffy fur coat acts as a sensor, enabling it to read the feelings of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Ditto ◇

cards.flavorText: With its astonishing capacity for metamorphosis, it can get along with anything. It does not get along well with its fellow Ditto.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.flavorText: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Stantler

attacks.name: Mystifying Horns
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Enhanced Horns
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The curved antlers change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

cards.name: Smeargle

attacks.name: Stunning Likeness
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may use the effect of a Supporter card you find there as the effect of this attack.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It draws symbols all over the place to mark its territory. In towns with many Smeargle, the walls are covered in graffiti.

cards.name: Miltank

attacks.name: Milk Cannon
attacks.text: Reveal any number of Moomoo Milk cards in your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you revealed in this way.

cards.flavorText: Most people raise it for its milk, but it's quite tough and strong, so it's also well suited for battle.

cards.name: Lugia-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pelagic Blade
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Pelagic Blade during your next turn.

attacks.name: Lost Purge-GX
attacks.text: Put your opponent's Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Ho-Oh

attacks.name: Rainbow Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

cards.name: Kecleon

abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon has Unit Energy GrassFireWater attached to it, it is a Grass, Fire, and Water Pokémon.

attacks.name: Tongue Smack
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It changes its shading to match its surroundings so it can sneak up on prey. Only its belly patterns stay fixed.

• If you played 2 cards, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. (This effects works one time for 2 cards.)
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Electropower
rules: During this turn, your Lightning Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Lost Blender
rules: Put 2 cards from your hand in the Lost Zone. If you do, draw a card.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Net Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Grass Pokémon or a Grass Energy card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Spell Tag
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it.
When the Psychic Pokémon this card is attached to is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Wait and See Hammer
rules: You can use this card only if you go second, and only on your first turn.
Discard an Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Celebi & Venusaur-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Pollen Hazard
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Confused, and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Evergreen-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from this Pokémon. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Grass Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), shuffle all cards from your discard pile into your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Tangle Drag
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Kakuna

abilities.name: Grass Cushion
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has any Grass Energy attached to it, it takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Destiny Stinger
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if this Pokémon has any damage counters on it. Both Active Pokémon are Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.

cards.name: Paras
cards.flavorText: Whether it's due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don't grow up quite right.

cards.name: Parasect

abilities.name: Panic Spores
abilities.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Confused Pokémon between turns.

attacks.name: Mysterious Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

cards.name: Exeggcute

attacks.name: Bullet Seed
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

cards.name: Pinsir

attacks.name: Grip and Squeeze
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Guillotine Hug
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.

cards.flavorText: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.

cards.name: Shaymin ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

attacks.name: Flower Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of basic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Reprisal
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Roaring Resolve
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 2 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for up to 2 Fire Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Continuous Blaze Ball
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 50 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Vulpix

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.

cards.name: Ninetales

abilities.name: Nine Temptations
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 2 Fire Energy cards from your hand. If you do, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.

cards.name: Ponyta

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Moltres

attacks.name: Top Burner
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy from this Pokémon. Then, discard a card from the top of your opponent's deck for each Energy you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Fire Spin
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said to be the legendary bird Pokémon of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flare of flames.

cards.name: Litten

attacks.name: Fasten Claws
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It doesn't allow its emotions to be easily seen. Earning its trust takes time. It prefers solitude.

cards.name: Torracat

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

cards.name: Squirtle

abilities.name: Floating Shell
abilities.text: If you have a Stadium card in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.flavorText: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

cards.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Powerful Squall
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach any number of Water Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

attacks.name: Hydro Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Headache
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from their hand during their next turn.

cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Amnesia
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Swim
attacks.text: If any of your opponent's Pokémon have any Water Energy attached to them, you may do 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon instead of their Active Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Staryu

attacks.name: Numbing Water
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: In many places, there are folktales of stardust falling into the ocean and becoming Staryu.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Enter the Dragon
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put a card that evolves from this Pokémon from your discard pile onto this Pokémon to evolve it.

cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Distilled Blast
attacks.text: Reveal the top 7 cards of your deck. This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Water Energy you find there. Then, shuffle those Energy cards back into your deck and discard the other cards.

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."

cards.name: Lapras

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage times the amount of Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.

cards.name: Articuno

abilities.name: Blizzard Veil
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to your Benched Water Pokémon.

attacks.name: Cold Cyclone
attacks.text: Move 2 Water Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Pikachu & Zekrom-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Full Blitz

attacks.name: Tag Bolt-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Geodude

attacks.name: Self-Destruct
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 60 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Geodude

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Smash Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: If you mistake it for a rock and step on it, it will headbutt you in anger. In addition to the pain, it will also zap you with a shock.

cards.name: Alolan Graveler
cards.flavorText: When two Graveler fight each other, it fills the surroundings with flashes of light and sound. People call it the "fireworks of the earth."

cards.name: Alolan Golem

attacks.name: Electromagnetic Bomb
attacks.text: Move any number of Lightning Energy from your Benched Pokémon to this Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage for each Energy card you moved in this way.

attacks.name: Super Zap Cannon
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it discharges electricity from the surface of its body and growls with a voice like thunder.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.flavorText: It was discovered when Poké Balls were introduced. It is said that there is some connection.

cards.name: Electrode

abilities.name: Electro Shaker
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may move any number of Lightning Energy from your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

cards.name: Zapdos

attacks.name: Thunderous Assault
attacks.text: If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 70 more damage. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

cards.flavorText: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

cards.name: Mareep

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

cards.name: Flaaffy

attacks.name: Shock Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

cards.name: Ampharos-GX

attacks.name: Impact Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Electrical-GX
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 7 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Blitzle

attacks.name: Delivery Dash
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Electropower cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.text: If this Pokémon evolved from Blitzle during this turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Emolga

abilities.name: Nuzzly Gathering
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Pokémon that has the Nuzzle attack, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Nuzzle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks and makes a meal of them. It usually nests in the holes gouged in trees by Pikipek.

cards.name: Joltik

attacks.name: Leech Life
attacks.text: Heal from this Pokémon the same amount of damage you did to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula

abilities.name: Unnerve
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent plays an Item or Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spider Thread
attacks.text: Put a card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.flavorText: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

cards.name: Heliolisk

attacks.name: Random Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Volt Switch
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Lightning Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It stimulates its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs and enabling it to run 100 yards in five seconds.

cards.name: Tapu Koko ◇
rules: ◇ (Prism Star) Rule: You can't have more than 1 ◇ card with the same name in your deck. If a ◇ card would go to the discard pile, put it in the Lost Zone instead.

abilities.name: Dance of the Ancients
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may choose 2 of your Benched Pokémon and attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to each of them. If you do, discard all cards from this Pokémon and put it in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

cards.name: Zeraora

attacks.name: Wild Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

cards.name: Gengar & Mimikyu-GX

attacks.name: Horror House-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Psychic Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), each player draws cards until they have 7 cards in their hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Nidoran ♀

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Although small, its venomous barbs render this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

cards.name: Nidorina

attacks.name: Family Rescue
attacks.text: Shuffle 5 Psychic Pokémon from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.flavorText: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

cards.name: Nidoqueen

abilities.name: Queen's Call
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a Pokémon that isn't a Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Power Lariat
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Evolution Pokémon on your Bench.

cards.flavorText: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

cards.name: Nidoran ♂
cards.flavorText: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

cards.name: Nidorino
cards.flavorText: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. If it senses anything, it attacks immediately.

cards.name: Nidoking

attacks.name: Drag Off
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage to the new Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: King's Drum
attacks.text: If Nidoqueen is on your Bench, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn, as it contains venom.

cards.name: Tentacool

attacks.name: Wrap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.

cards.name: Tentacruel

attacks.name: Void Tentacles
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Paranormal
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Ultra Beasts.

cards.flavorText: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.flavorText: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.

cards.name: Muk

abilities.name: Poison Sacs
abilities.text: The Special Condition Poisoned is not removed when your opponent's Pokémon evolve or devolve.

attacks.name: Toxic Secretion
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.

cards.name: Alolan Marowak

attacks.name: Limbo Limbo
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Alolan Club
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon in play that has Alolan in its name.

cards.flavorText: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

cards.name: Starmie

attacks.name: Strange Wave
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Water and Psychic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its sparkling core is called "the gem of the sea." This core can be made into high-priced accessories that are traded in secret.

cards.name: Mr. Mime

abilities.name: Scoop-Up Block
abilities.text: Your opponent's Pokémon that have any damage counters on them, and any cards attached to those Pokémon, can't be put into your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Mr. Mime-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Magic Odds
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by your opponent's attacks if that damage is exactly 10, 30, 50, 70, 90, 110, 130, 150, 170, 190, 210, 230, or 250.

attacks.name: Breakdown
attacks.text: For each card in your opponent's hand, put 1 damage counter on their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Life Trick-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Jynx

attacks.name: Dazzle Dance
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Mysterious Dance
attacks.text: For each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.

cards.name: Cosmog

abilities.name: Cosmic Guard
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.flavorText: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

cards.name: Cosmoem

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Heal 20 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokémon may come from another world.

cards.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

cards.flavorText: The smallest of things could cause it to lose its temper. Because it doesn't hold in its stress, this Pokémon can live a long time.

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Wreck
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 80 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.

cards.flavorText: It will never forgive opponents who have angered it. Even after it has beaten them down until they can't move, it never ever forgives.

cards.name: Hitmonlee

attacks.name: Special Combo
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if your Hitmonchan used Hit and Run during your last turn. This attack does 90 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

cards.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Hit and Run
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

cards.name: Omanyte

attacks.name: Tickle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Omanyte lived in the seas of antiquity. Its fossils have been found bearing bite marks from Archeops, so apparently Archeops preyed on it.

cards.name: Omastar

abilities.name: Fossil Bind
abilities.text: As long as you have fewer Pokémon in play than your opponent, they can't play any Item cards from their hand.

cards.flavorText: Its heavy shell is thought to be the reason this ancient Pokémon died out. It's apparently a distant ancestor of Octillery.

cards.name: Kabuto

attacks.name: Ramming Shell
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It's said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

cards.name: Kabutops

abilities.name: Fossilized Memories
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Supporter cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its body had begun to change so it could function on land. But it didn't adapt in time and went extinct.

cards.name: Larvitar

attacks.name: Chip Away
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar

attacks.name: Payback
attacks.text: If your opponent has exactly 1 Prize card remaining, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

cards.name: Pancham

attacks.name: Arm Thrust
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

cards.name: Lycanroc-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Twilight Eyes
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Splintered Shards-GX

cards.name: Alolan Muk

cards.name: Poochyena

cards.name: Mightyena

attacks.name: Dark Fang

cards.flavorText: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

cards.name: Absol

attacks.name: Shadow Seeker

cards.flavorText: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokémon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.

cards.name: Spiritomb

attacks.name: Spirit Compressor

cards.flavorText: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago

cards.name: Zorua

cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Night Punishment
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile. You can't do more than 200 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

cards.name: Vullaby

attacks.name: Collect

cards.flavorText: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. Since it's still at a playful age, it hops around friskily.

cards.name: Mandibuzz

cards.name: Bronzor

attacks.name: Poltergeist
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. This attack does 50 damage for each Trainer card you find there.

attacks.name: Horror House-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any cards from their hand during their next turn. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Psychic Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), each player draws cards until they have 7 cards in their hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

attacks.name: Rogue Ring

attacks.name: Dark Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Dark Strike during your next turn.

attacks.name: Devilish Hands-GX
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX 6 times. (You can choose the same Pokémon more than once.) For each time you chose a Pokémon, do 30 damage to it. This damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Incineroar-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Scar Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put 3 damage counters on this Pokémon. If you do, search your deck for up to 3 Darkness Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Crushing Punch
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Darkest Tornado-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Cobalion-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Metal Symbol
abilities.text: Each of your Pokémon that has any Metal Energy attached to it can't be affected by any Special Conditions. Remove any Special Conditions affecting those Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dueling Saber
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Iron Rule-GX
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, their Pokémon can't attack. (This includes Pokémon that come into play on that turn.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Latias & Latios-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Buster Purge
attacks.text: Discard 3 Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aero Unit-GX
attacks.text: Attach 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to it during your opponent's next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Cheer Up
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dump Truck Press
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 120 more damage.

attacks.name: Megaton Friends-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), draw cards until you have 10 cards in your hand. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Brock's Grit
rules: Shuffle 6 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Dana
rules: You can play this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Stage 2 Pokémon.
Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Erika's Hospitality
rules: You can play this card only if you have 4 or fewer other cards in your hand.
Draw a card for each of your opponent's Pokémon in play.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Evelyn
rules: You can play this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Stage 1 Pokémon.
Draw 4 cards.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Ingo & Emmet
rules:
Look at the top card of your deck, and then choose 1:
• Discard your hand and draw 5 cards.
• Discard your hand and draw 5 cards from the bottom of your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Jasmine
rules: Search your deck for a Metal Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you go second and it's your first turn, search for 5 Metal Pokémon instead of 1. Then, shuffle your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Morgan
rules: You can play this card only if you discard Dana, Evelyn, and Nita from your hand.
Look at the top 12 cards of your deck and attach any number of Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Nanu
rules: Choose a Basic Darkness Pokémon in your discard pile. Switch it with 1 of your Pokémon in play. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Nita
rules: You can play this card only if your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon.
Put an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon on top of their deck.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Sabrina's Suggestion
rules: Your opponent reveals their hand. You may choose a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this card.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Celebi & Venusaur-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Pollen Hazard
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Confused, and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Evergreen-GX
attacks.text: Heal all damage from this Pokémon. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Grass Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), shuffle all cards from your discard pile into your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Magikarp & Wailord-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Towering Splash-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 7 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 100 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Pikachu & Zekrom-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Full Blitz
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Tag Bolt-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Ampharos-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Power Recharge
attacks.text: Put all Electropower cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Impact Bolt
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Electrical-GX
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 7 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
