cards.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Gloom

attacks.name: Sleep Powder
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Vileplume-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Fragrant Flower Garden
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Massive Bloom
attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Allergic Explosion-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Paralyzed, and Poisoned. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Tangela

attacks.name: Toxic
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Tangrowth

attacks.name: Grass Knot
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Sunkern

attacks.name: Leech Seed
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

cards.name: Sunflora

attacks.name: Solar Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, ignore all Energy in the attack costs of Grass Pokémon and Fire Pokémon. (This includes Pokémon that come into play on that turn.)

cards.flavorText: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.

cards.name: Heracross

attacks.name: Riled Horn
attacks.text: If your opponent has any TAG TEAM Pokémon in play, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

cards.name: Lileep

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.

cards.name: Cradily

abilities.name: Swaying Strangle
abilities.text: Your opponent's Pokémon that are affected by Special Conditions can't retreat.

attacks.name: Poison Tentacles
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

cards.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Synthesis
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.

cards.name: Kricketot

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

cards.name: Kricketune

attacks.name: Improvisational Performance
attacks.text: If you have exactly 1 card in your hand, this attack does 100 more damage. If you have exactly 3 cards in your hand, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. If you have exactly 6 cards in your hand, this attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.flavorText: Their coloring changes according to the season and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

cards.name: Sawsbuck

abilities.name: Seasonal Blessings
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card.

attacks.name: Bounce
attacks.text: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Rowlet

attacks.name: Hide and Seek
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Rowlet

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Dartrix

attacks.name: Wing Flick
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

cards.name: Decidueye

attacks.name: Skill Dive
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Tracking Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

cards.name: Buzzwole

abilities.name: Beast Boost
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Prize card you have taken (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Touchdown
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Charizard & Braixen-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Brilliant Flare
attacks.text: You may search your deck for up to 3 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Crimson Flame Pillar-GX
attacks.text: Attach 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like. If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Ponyta

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Rapidash

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Flareon

abilities.name: Power Cheer
abilities.text: The attacks of your Pokémon-GX in play that evolve from Eevee do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Power Cheer Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

cards.name: Slugma

attacks.name: Singe
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Magcargo

attacks.name: Stomp Off
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Flamethrower
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Entei

attacks.name: Rally Back
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Torkoal

attacks.name: Fire Fling
attacks.text: Put 4 Fire Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Kindle
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

cards.name: Victini

abilities.name: Victory Heal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 20 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

cards.name: Emboar

abilities.name: Explosive Fire Dance
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may look at the top 8 cards of your deck and attach any number of basic Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.flavorText: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Volcarona-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Flaming Shot
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Backfire
attacks.text: Put 2 Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

attacks.name: Massive Heat Wave-GX
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Litleo
cards.flavorText: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.

cards.name: Pyroar

attacks.name: Swirling Inferno
attacks.text: Discard all Pokémon Tool cards and Special Energy from each of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

cards.name: Blastoise & Piplup-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Splash Maker
attacks.text: You may attach up to 3 Water Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, heal 50 damage from those Pokémon for each card you attached to them in this way.

attacks.name: Bubble Launcher-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 150 more damage. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix

abilities.name: Snowed In
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.flavorText: If you carelessly approach it because it's cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Confusion Wave
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck

attacks.name: Energy Loop
attacks.text: Put an Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

cards.flavorText: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Vaporeon

abilities.name: Vitality Cheer
abilities.text: Your Pokémon-GX in play that evolve from Eevee get +60 HP. You can't apply more than 1 Vitality Cheer Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Refreshing Rain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

cards.name: Sneasel

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

cards.name: Weavile

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.flavorText: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.flavorText: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.

cards.name: Snorunt

attacks.name: Continuous Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

cards.name: Glalie

attacks.name: Ice Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed, and discard an Energy from that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Frosty Typhoon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Frosty Typhoon during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Spheal

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.flavorText: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

cards.name: Walrein

attacks.name: Cold Snap
attacks.text: Your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from their hand during their next turn. If 1 of your Pokémon used Cold Snap during your last turn, this attack can't be used.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Kyogre

attacks.name: High Water
attacks.text: Attach 2 Water Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Swirling Waves
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Piplup

attacks.name: Bubble Hold
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

cards.name: Prinplup

attacks.name: Direct Dive
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

cards.name: Empoleon

attacks.name: Recall
attacks.text: Choose an attack from 1 of this Pokémon's previous Evolutions and use it as this attack.

attacks.name: Aquafall
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

cards.name: Phione

abilities.name: Whirlpool Suction
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. If you do, discard all cards attached to this Pokémon and put it on the bottom of your deck.

cards.flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

cards.name: Tympole

attacks.name: Flail Around
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

cards.name: Ducklett

attacks.name: Aerial Ace
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

cards.name: Swanna

attacks.name: Tailwind
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

cards.name: Black Kyurem

attacks.name: Frozen Wings
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dazzling Blizzard
attacks.text: If you have any Stadium card in play, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Wishiwashi

abilities.name: Scatter
abilities.text: At the end of your opponent's turn, if this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, flip a coin. If tails, shuffle this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your deck.

cards.flavorText: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

cards.name: Wishiwashi-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: School Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Wishiwashi and Wishiwashi-GX in play.

attacks.name: Massive Catch-GX
attacks.text: Look at the top 12 cards of your deck and put any number of Basic Pokémon you find there onto your Bench. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.flavorText: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

cards.name: Araquanid

attacks.name: Liquidation
attacks.text: During your next turn, the Defending Pokémon takes 60 more damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Nuzzle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Volt Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Nuzzle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Powerful Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the amount of Lightning Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

cards.name: Magnemite

attacks.name: Mirror Shot
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

cards.flavorText: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Magneton

abilities.name: Call Signal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for up to 3 Supporter cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. If you searched your deck in this way, this Pokémon is Knocked Out.

cards.flavorText: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

cards.name: Jolteon

abilities.name: Speed Cheer
abilities.text: The attacks of your Pokémon-GX in play that evolve from Eevee cost Colorless less. You can't apply more than 1 Speed Cheer Ability at a time.

cards.flavorText: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

cards.name: Chinchou

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

cards.flavorText: Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.

cards.name: Lanturn

abilities.name: Blinking Lights
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Swirling Flow
attacks.text: You may have your opponent shuffle their deck.

cards.flavorText: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn's bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.

cards.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Random Spark
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

cards.name: Togedemaru

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

cards.name: Solgaleo & Lunala-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Cosmic Burn
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Cosmic Burn during your next turn.

attacks.name: Light of the Protector-GX
attacks.text: If you played Lillie's Full Force from your hand during this turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to each of your Pokémon during your opponent's next turn. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Koffing

abilities.name: Blow-Away Bomb
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you discard this Pokémon with the effect of Roxie, you may put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Place damage counters after the effect of Roxie.)

attacks.name: Poison Gas
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing

abilities.name: Blow-Away Bomb
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you discard this Pokémon with the effect of Roxie, you may put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Place damage counters after the effect of Roxie.)

attacks.name: Balloon Burst
attacks.text: Discard this Pokémon and all cards attached to it.

cards.flavorText: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Natu

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 4 cards of either player's deck and put them back in any order.

cards.flavorText: Although it still can't fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.

cards.name: Xatu

attacks.name: Creepy Wind
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Life Drain
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 10.

cards.flavorText: It's said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it's not powerful enough to change the future it sees.

cards.name: Ralts

attacks.name: Teleport
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Gallade

abilities.name: Double Type
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, it is Psychic and Fighting type.

attacks.name: Power Cyclone
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

cards.name: Duskull

abilities.name: Spiritborne Evolution
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 3 cards from your hand. If you do, search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Ominous Eyes
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Dusclops

attacks.name: Disable
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

cards.name: Dusknoir

abilities.name: Grim Marking
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Psych Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psych Up attack does 60 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Rotom

attacks.name: Cycle Draw
attacks.text: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Attach 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Woobat

attacks.name: Nasal Suction
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Air Cutter
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Swoobat

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Charming Stamp
attacks.text: Your opponent chooses 1 of their own Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

cards.name: Golett

attacks.name: Return
attacks.text: You may draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

cards.flavorText: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.

cards.name: Golurk

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Fist of Antiquity
attacks.text: If you have any Supporter cards in your discard pile, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master's orders faithfully.

cards.name: Skrelp

attacks.name: Poison Breath
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.

cards.name: Dragalge

attacks.name: Poison Cultivation
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, put 10 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.flavorText: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It's trying to make friends with them.

cards.name: Trevenant

attacks.name: Perplexing Forest
attacks.text: You may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Shadow Impact
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

cards.name: Oricorio-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Dance of Tribute
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, you may draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Dance of Tribute Ability each turn.

attacks.name: Strafe-GX
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Mimikyu

attacks.name: Impersonation
attacks.text: Discard a Supporter card from your hand. If you do, use the effect of that card as the effect of this attack.

attacks.name: Mischievous Hands
attacks.text: Choose 2 of your opponent's Pokémon and put 2 damage counters on each of them.

cards.flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Mimikyu

abilities.name: Shadow Box
abilities.text: Pokémon-GX that have any damage counters on them (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities.

attacks.name: Tail Trickery
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Dhelmise

attacks.name: Seaweed Grab
attacks.text: Put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Buster Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

cards.name: Cosmog

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Cosmog

abilities.name: Unaware
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, except damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Cosmoem

attacks.name: Stiffen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the "cocoon of the stars" and built an altar to worship it.

cards.name: Lunala

abilities.name: Blessing of the Moone
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Solgaleo in play, you may search your deck for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to your Solgaleo or Lunala in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name "the beast that calls the moon."

cards.name: Marshadow

attacks.name: Shadow Imitation
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's non-GX attacks and use it as this attack.

cards.flavorText: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

cards.name: Blacephalon

attacks.name: Fireworks Bomb
attacks.text: Put 4 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like. If your opponent has exactly 3 Prize cards remaining, put 12 damage counters on them instead.

cards.flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Onix

attacks.name: Dig Deep
attacks.text: Put an Energy card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Tail Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

cards.name: Nosepass

attacks.name: Draw Toward
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zap Cannon
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Zap Cannon during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it's in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

cards.name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Nest Building
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

cards.name: Trapinch

attacks.name: Dig
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

cards.name: Vibrava

abilities.name: Obnoxious Whirring
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.

cards.name: Flygon-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Dusty Defense
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Desert Hurricane
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, this attack does 120 more damage. Then, discard that Stadium card.

attacks.name: Sonic Edge-GX
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Anorith
cards.flavorText: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don't thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.

cards.name: Armaldo

attacks.name: Ancient Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Unidentified Fossil card in your discard pile.

attacks.name: Mach Claw
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.

cards.name: Groudon

attacks.name: Drought
attacks.text: Attach up to 2 Fighting Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Trembling Ground
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Trembling Ground during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

cards.name: Drilbur

attacks.name: Rototiller
attacks.text: Shuffle a card from your discard pile into your deck.

cards.flavorText: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill

attacks.name: Eleventh Hour Tackle
attacks.text: If there are 3 or fewer cards in your deck, this attack does 150 more damage.

attacks.name: Drill Bazooka
attacks.text: Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

cards.flavorText: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Palpitoad

attacks.name: Mini Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

cards.name: Seismitoad

abilities.name: Bulldoze
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your deck for a card, shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of it.

attacks.name: Tremulous Fist
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.flavorText: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

cards.name: Throh

attacks.name: Reverse Shoulder Throw
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.flavorText: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.flavorText: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.flavorText: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

cards.name: Crabominable

abilities.name: Solid Shell
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Freezing Punch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Water Energy attached to it, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

cards.name: Rockruff

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

cards.name: Lycanroc

abilities.name: Boiling Blood
abilities.text: If your opponent has any Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX in play, this Pokémon's attacks cost ColorlessColorlessColorless less.

attacks.name: Voltage Claw
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Special Energy attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

cards.name: Passimian

attacks.name: Spike Draw
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

cards.flavorText: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

cards.name: Sandygast

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose a random card from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals that card and shuffles it into their deck.

cards.flavorText: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

cards.name: Palossand

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 20 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth

attacks.name: Swagger
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

cards.name: Alolan Persian-GX
rules: Pokémon-GX rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Smug Face
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon by your opponent's TAG TEAM Pokémon and Ultra Beasts, and by your opponent's Pokémon that have any Special Energy attached to them.

attacks.name: Stalking Claws-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, or any other effects on that Pokémon. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Alolan Grimer

attacks.name: Nasty Goo
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

cards.name: Alolan Muk

attacks.name: Panic Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned, Confused, and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: There are over a hundred kinds of poison inside its body. Chemical reactions between different poisons are the source of its vitality.

cards.name: Carvanha

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

cards.name: Absol

attacks.name: Ominous News
attacks.text: Discard a Special Energy from 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dirty Throw
attacks.text: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't discard a card, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.

cards.name: Pawniard

attacks.name: Bag Slash
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. Discard an Item card you find there.

cards.flavorText: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

cards.name: Bisharp

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.

cards.name: Guzzlord

attacks.name: Mountain Munch
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Red Banquet
attacks.text: If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card.

cards.flavorText: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew

attacks.name: Run Around
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: After fleeing a volcanic eruption, it ended up moving to an area of snowy mountains. Its ice shell is as hard as steel.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash

attacks.name: Curve Strike
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Reinforced Needle
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

cards.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Thumping Fall
attacks.text: Discard any number of Pokémon with a Retreat Cost of exactly 4 from your hand. This attack does 50 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Iron Tail
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 100 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Dual Calling
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 TAG TEAM cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Dark Clamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.

cards.name: Probopass

attacks.name: Hard Press
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Triple Nose
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

cards.name: Solgaleo

abilities.name: Armor of the Sunne
abilities.text: If you have Lunala in play, your Solgaleo and Lunala take 50 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Armor of the Sunne Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Sol Fangs
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

attacks.text: Take another turn after this one. (Skip the between-turns step.) If this Pokémon has at least 14 extra Fairy Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), your opponent shuffles all of their Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to them into their deck. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Togepi & Cleffa & Igglybuff-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.text: Take another turn after this one. (Skip the between-turns step.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Clefairy

attacks.name: Doll Swap
attacks.text: Put this Pokémon and all cards attached to it into your hand. If you do, you may play Lillie's Poké Doll from your hand as your new Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales

attacks.name: Rubbish Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each Pokémon Tool card in your discard pile.

cards.flavorText: The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain's base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.

cards.name: Azurill

abilities.name: Growing Up
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Pokémon. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

cards.name: Cottonee

attacks.name: Lost March
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon, except p (Prism Star) Pokémon, in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Whimsicott

attacks.name: Sneaky Pocket
attacks.text: Put a card from your hand in the Lost Zone. If you do, draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Lost March
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Pokémon, except p (Prism Star) Pokémon, in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

cards.name: Flabébé

attacks.name: Floral Invitation
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Fairy Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

cards.name: Flabébé

attacks.name: Petal Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

cards.name: Floette

abilities.name: Flower Picking
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 2 random cards from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals those cards and shuffles them into their deck.

cards.flavorText: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

cards.name: Florges

abilities.name: Flower Picking
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may choose 2 random cards from your opponent's hand. Your opponent reveals those cards and shuffles them into their deck.

attacks.name: Petal Dance
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads. This Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

cards.name: Swirlix

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

cards.name: Slurpuff

attacks.name: Olfactory Enchantment
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Sweet Panic
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon isn't Confused, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

cards.name: Sylveon

attacks.name: Moonblast
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Beloved Pulse
attacks.text: If you played a TAG TEAM Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.

cards.name: Arceus & Dialga & Palkia-GX

attacks.name: Altered Creation-GX
attacks.text: For the rest of this game, your Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Water Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), when your opponent's Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from those attacks, take 1 more Prize card. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Reshiram & Zekrom-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Fabled Flarebolts
attacks.text: Discard up to 3 in any combination of basic Fire and basic Lightning Energy cards from your Benched Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Cross Break-GX
attacks.text: This attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If you played N's Resolve from your hand during this turn, this attack also does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's other Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Naganadel & Guzzlord-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Violent Appetite
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Pokémon from your hand. If you do, heal 60 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Chaotic Order-GX
attacks.text: Turn all of your Prize cards face up. (Those Prize cards remain face up for the rest of the game.) If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Psychic Energy and 1 extra Darkness Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), take 2 Prize cards. (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Dragon Arcana
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has 2 or more different types of basic Energy attached to it, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.

cards.name: Jangmo-o

attacks.name: Raging Claws
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.flavorText: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

cards.name: Hakamo-o

abilities.name: Fighter's Roar
abilities.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-EX, this Pokémon can evolve during the turn you play it.

cards.flavorText: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

cards.name: Kommo-o

attacks.name: Shout of Power
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Scaly Uppercut
attacks.text: You may discard a Pokémon Tool card from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.

cards.name: Ultra Necrozma

abilities.name: Ultra Burst
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't attack unless your opponent has 2 or fewer Prize cards remaining.

attacks.name: Luster of Downfall
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

cards.name: Mega Lopunny & Jigglypuff-GX
rules: TAG TEAM rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Jumping Balloon
attacks.text: This attack does 60 more damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon-GX and Pokémon-EX in play.

attacks.name: Puffy Smashers-GX
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. If this Pokémon has at least 4 extra Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 200 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Follow My Tail
attacks.text: Search your deck for any number of Eevee and Eevee-GX and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Igglybuff

abilities.name: Sleepy Voice
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.flavorText: It's always practicing its singing because it wants to improve. Even when it's asleep, it keeps singing in its dreams!

cards.name: Aipom

abilities.name: Scampering Tail
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may put the top card of your opponent's deck on the bottom of their deck without looking at it.

cards.flavorText: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

cards.name: Ambipom

attacks.name: Nice-Nice Catch
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Bye-Bye Throw
attacks.text: Discard up to 2 cards from your hand. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

cards.name: Ursaring

attacks.name: Heavy Hold
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Zangoose

attacks.name: Brutal Edge
attacks.text: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

cards.name: Lillipup

attacks.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can't defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.

cards.name: Herdier

attacks.name: Work Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 60 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can't easily penetrate it.

cards.name: Stoutland

abilities.name: Arf Arf Bark
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon. If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, you may discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

cards.name: Rufflet

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.

cards.name: Braviary

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Aero Fall
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.

cards.name: Helioptile

attacks.name: Tail Whip
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Heliolisk

attacks.name: Parabolic Counter
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Lightning Pokémon in play, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Stufful

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Bewear

abilities.name: Carry and Run
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless less.

attacks.name: Lariat
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

cards.name: Type: Null

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

rules: Discard 3 cards from the top of each player's deck.
When you play this card, you may discard 3 other cards from your hand. If you do, each player discards their Benched Pokémon until they have 3 Benched Pokémon. Your opponent discards first.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.name: Chaotic Swell
rules: Whenever either player plays a Stadium card from their hand, discard that Stadium card after discarding this one. (The new Stadium card has no effect.)
This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

cards.flavorText: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

cards.flavorText: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculegion

attacks.name: Grudge Dive
attacks.text: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon during their last turn, this attack does 90 more damage, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

cards.name: Wyrdeer

abilities.name: Hurried Gait
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may draw a card.

attacks.name: Extrasensory
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

cards.name: Hisuian Samurott

abilities.name: Wily Stance
abilities.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Dark Mastery
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

cards.name: Magnezone

abilities.name: Giga Magnet
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 6 cards of your deck and attach any number of Metal Energy cards you find there to your Pokémon in any way you like. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.flavorText: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

cards.name: Toxel

attacks.name: Growl
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.

cards.name: Oricorio

attacks.name: Mixed Call
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon and a Supporter card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Some dancers use its graceful, elegant dancing as inspiration.

cards.name: Sylveon

attacks.name: Time Out Kick
attacks.text: You may put an Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon into their hand.

attacks.name: Symphony Whip
attacks.text: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: There's a Galarian fairy tale that describes a beautiful Sylveon vanquishing a dreadful dragon Pokémon.

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Be Prepared

cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.flavorText: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

cards.name: Cyndaquil

attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop."

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.flavorText: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Tail on Fire
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.flavorText: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

cards.flavorText: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy

abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon that has the Swim Freely attack.

cards.flavorText: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

cards.name: Gengar

abilities.name: Netherworld Gate
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in your discard pile, you may put it onto your Bench. If you do, put 3 damage counters on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Screaming Circle
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

cards.name: Comfey

abilities.name: Flower Selecting
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

cards.flavorText: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

cards.name: Scorbunny

attacks.name: Flaring Dash

cards.flavorText: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.flavorText: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.

cards.name: Weavile

attacks.name: Pursuit Claw
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.

cards.flavorText: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

cards.name: Rapidash

abilities.name: Heat Boost
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may discard a Fire Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. During this turn, your Fire Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

cards.name: Kirlia

abilities.name: Refinement
abilities.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

cards.flavorText: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

cards.name: Archeops

abilities.name: Primal Turbo
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Special Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

cards.name: Hisuian Basculin

attacks.name: Submerge Silently
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only during your first turn. During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

cards.flavorText: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor - this one is gentle - I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

cards.name: Cranidos

attacks.name: Stone Edge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.

cards.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Pulling Currents
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. Put up to 2 Basic Pokémon you find there onto your opponent's Bench.

attacks.name: Aqua Bullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It starts life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Togetic

abilities.name: Voice of Happiness
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may heal 30 damage from your Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

cards.name: Rillaboom

attacks.name: Wood Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Raging Repeated Strike
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 30 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

cards.name: Cinderace

abilities.name: Crisis Power
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Fireball Shot
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.flavorText: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

cards.name: Inteleon

abilities.name: Quick Shooting
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
