attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.flavorText: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

cards.name: Decidueye

abilities.name: Deep Forest Camo
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon V and Pokémon-GX.

attacks.name: Splitting Arrow
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

cards.name: Grookey

attacks.name: Fury Swipes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Thwackey

abilities.name: Lay of the Land
abilities.text: If you have a Stadium in play, this Pokémon has no Retreat Cost.

cards.flavorText: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

cards.name: Rillaboom

abilities.name: Voltage Beat
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Grass Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

cards.name: Blipbug
cards.flavorText: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

cards.name: Dottler

attacks.name: Reflect
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 40 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

cards.name: Orbeetle

abilities.name: Bug's Radar
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck and put them back in any order.

attacks.name: Brainwave
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

cards.name: Gossifleur

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

cards.name: Eldegoss

attacks.name: Blessing of Fluff
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Grass Energy cards and attach them to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Applin

attacks.name: Withdraw
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

cards.flavorText: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

cards.name: Flapple

abilities.name: Apple Drop
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

attacks.name: Acid Spray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

cards.name: Appletun

abilities.name: Delicious Aroma
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Basic Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

cards.name: Scorbunny

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

cards.name: Raboot

attacks.name: Flame Charge
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

cards.name: Cinderace

abilities.name: Libero
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when this Pokémon moves from your Bench to the Active Spot, you may attach up to 2 Fire Energy cards from your discard pile to it.

attacks.name: Flare Striker
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.flavorText: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

cards.name: Centiskorch

attacks.name: Hundred Foot Flames
attacks.text: For each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Mime

attacks.name: Reflect
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Rime

abilities.name: Shuffle Dance
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's face-down Prize cards with the top card of their deck. (The cards stay face down.)

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

cards.flavorText: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

cards.name: Suicune

attacks.name: Aurora Loop
attacks.text: Put 2 Water Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

cards.flavorText: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Galarian Darumaka

attacks.name: Ice Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Crushing Headbutt
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Crushing Headbutt.

cards.flavorText: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

cards.name: Sobble
cards.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Drizzile

abilities.name: Shady Dealings
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Trainer cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

cards.name: Inteleon

abilities.name: Shady Dealings
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Trainer cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Aqua Bullet
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

cards.name: Chewtle
cards.flavorText: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

cards.name: Drednaw

attacks.name: Vise Bite
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Jaw Lock
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

cards.name: Cramorant

attacks.name: Dive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

cards.name: Arrokuda
cards.flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

cards.name: Barraskewda

attacks.name: Spiral Jet
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy cards from your hand. If you don't, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

cards.name: Snom

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

cards.name: Frosmoth

abilities.name: Ice Dance
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Water Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Water Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Eiscue

abilities.name: Ice Face
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has full HP, it takes 60 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

cards.name: Dracovish

abilities.name: Primal Law
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent can't play any Pokémon from their hand to evolve their Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

cards.name: Arctovish

attacks.name: Hard Face
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Cold Breath
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

cards.name: Rotom

abilities.name: Roto Choice
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 Item cards that have the word "Rotom" in their name, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

cards.name: Yamper

attacks.name: Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

cards.name: Boltund

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Fighting Fangs
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V or Pokémon-GX, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

cards.name: Toxtricity

attacks.name: Risk Taker
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 5 cards of your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 5 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Thunder Jolt
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

cards.name: Pincurchin

attacks.name: Shocking Needles
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads. If at least 2 of them are heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

cards.name: Morpeko

attacks.name: Torment
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't use that attack.

attacks.name: Spark
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Dracozolt

attacks.name: Amping Up
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Amping Up attack does 90 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.flavorText: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

cards.name: Arctozolt

abilities.name: Biting Whirlpool
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent attaches an Energy card from their hand to 1 of their Pokémon, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

cards.name: Galarian Ponyta

attacks.name: Psy Bolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

cards.name: Galarian Rapidash

abilities.name: Pastel Veil
abilities.text: Your Pokémon recover from all Special Conditions and can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

cards.name: Galarian Corsola

attacks.name: Cursed Drop
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

cards.name: Galarian Cursola

abilities.name: Perish Body
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is Knocked Out by damage from an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.flavorText: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

cards.name: Dedenne

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

cards.flavorText: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

cards.name: Sinistea

attacks.name: Furtive Drop
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

cards.name: Polteageist

abilities.name: Tea Break
abilities.text: You must discard a Pokémon that has the Mad Party attack from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

cards.flavorText: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

cards.name: Hatenna

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

cards.name: Hattrem

attacks.name: Calm Mind
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Brutal Swing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

cards.name: Hatterene

abilities.name: Mind Hat
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Each player discards a card from their hand. (Your opponent discards first.)

attacks.name: Dripping Grudge
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Pokémon in your discard pile.

cards.flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

cards.name: Milcery

attacks.name: Aromatherapy
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

cards.name: Alcremie

attacks.name: Decorate
attacks.text: Attach any number of basic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Draining Kiss
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

cards.name: Indeedee

attacks.name: Replenish Time
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from each of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

cards.name: Dreepy

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

cards.name: Drakloak

attacks.name: Summon
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Dreepy and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

cards.name: Dragapult

abilities.name: Infiltrator
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Phantom Force
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

cards.name: Galarian Farfetch'd

attacks.name: Rock Smash
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

cards.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd

attacks.name: Meteor Assault
attacks.text: This Pokémon can't use Meteor Assault again until it leaves the Active Spot.

cards.flavorText: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

cards.name: Galarian Yamask

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

cards.name: Galarian Runerigus

attacks.name: Spreading Spite
attacks.text: For each damage counter on this Galarian Runerigus, put 2 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Mad Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

cards.name: Rolycoly
cards.flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

cards.name: Carkol
cards.flavorText: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

cards.name: Coalossal

abilities.name: Tar Generator
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may attach a Fire Energy card, a Fighting Energy card, or 1 of each from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Silicobra

attacks.name: Sand Attack
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

cards.flavorText: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

cards.name: Sandaconda

attacks.name: Coil
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's attacks do 120 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

cards.name: Clobbopus

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

cards.name: Grapploct

attacks.name: Octolock
attacks.text: Until this Grapploct leaves the Active Spot, the Defending Pokémon's attacks cost ColorlessColorless more, and the Defending Pokémon can't retreat. This effect can't be applied more than once.

attacks.name: Tough Swing
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

cards.name: Falinks

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Team Attack
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has "Falinks" in its name.

cards.flavorText: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

cards.name: Stonjourner

attacks.name: Power Press
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has at least 1 extra Energy attached (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

cards.name: Koffing

attacks.name: Ascension
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

cards.name: Galarian Weezing

abilities.name: Neutralizing Gas
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Neutralizing Gas.

attacks.name: Severe Poison
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 4 damage counters instead of 1 on that Pokémon during Pokémon Checkup.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

cards.name: Galarian Zigzagoon

abilities.name: Headbutt Tantrum
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

cards.name: Galarian Linoone

attacks.name: Night Slash
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

cards.name: Galarian Obstagoon

abilities.name: Untamed Shout
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may put 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Obstruct
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

cards.name: Nickit

attacks.name: Instigate
attacks.text: Your opponent shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If they put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, they draw 3 cards.

cards.flavorText: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Thievul

attacks.name: Thief
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand. Choose a card you find there and put it on the bottom of their deck.

cards.flavorText: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

cards.name: Impidimp
cards.flavorText: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

cards.name: Morgrem

attacks.name: False Surrender
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

cards.name: Grimmsnarl

abilities.name: Dark Oath
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless more.

attacks.name: Energy Press
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

cards.name: Galarian Meowth

abilities.name: Evolution Roar
abilities.text: You must discard 2 cards from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Galarian Perrserker, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

cards.name: Galarian Perrserker

abilities.name: Steely Spirit
abilities.text: Your Metal Pokémon's attacks do 20 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

cards.name: Galarian Stunfisk

abilities.name: Snap Trap
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an opponent's attack (even if it is Knocked Out), discard an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon.

attacks.name: Damage Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

cards.name: Corviknight

attacks.name: Iron Wings
attacks.text: You may discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, during your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 100 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

cards.name: Copperajah

abilities.name: Antibacterial Skin
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be affected by any Special Conditions.

attacks.name: Vengeful Stomp
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

cards.name: Duraludon

attacks.name: Metal Sharpener
attacks.text: Attach a Metal Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

cards.name: Minccino

attacks.name: Glance
attacks.text: Look at the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Tail Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

cards.name: Cinccino

abilities.name: Make Do
abilities.text: You must discard a card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Energy Assist
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.flavorText: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Swanna

abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.text: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

attacks.name: Feather Slice
attacks.text: You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Bunnelby

attacks.name: Mad Party
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each Pokémon in your discard pile that has the Mad Party attack.

cards.flavorText: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

cards.name: Oranguru

abilities.name: Primate Wisdom
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch a card from your hand with the top card of your deck.

cards.flavorText: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

cards.name: Greedent

abilities.name: Greedy Tail
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Pokémon Tool card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

cards.name: Corvisquire

attacks.name: Pluck
attacks.text: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

cards.name: Wooloo

attacks.name: Expand
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

cards.name: Dubwool

attacks.name: Cotton Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Double-Edge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

cards.name: Rillaboom V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Forest Feast
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Grass Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Wood Hammer
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.name: Rillaboom VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Max Beating
attacks.text: You may discard up to 3 Grass Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 50 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.name: Charizard VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Wildfire
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Centiskorch V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Radiating Heat
attacks.text: You may discard an Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Centiskorch VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Centiferno
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Fire Energy attached to this Pokémon. If you did any damage with this attack, you may attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Lapras V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Body Surf
attacks.text: Attach a Water Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon. If you do, switch it with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Ocean Loop
attacks.text: Put 2 Water Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

cards.name: Lapras VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Pump
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Toxtricity V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Poison Jab
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Electric Riot
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.name: Toxtricity VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Riot
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.name: Indeedee V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Watch Over
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may heal 20 damage from your Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: This attack does 60 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Falinks V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Iron Defense Formation
abilities.text: All of your Pokémon that have "Falinks" in their name take 20 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.name: Grimmsnarl V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spiky Knuckle
attacks.text: Put 2 Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon into your hand.

cards.name: Grimmsnarl VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Drill
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each extra Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon (in addition to this attack's cost). You can't add more than 100 damage in this way.

cards.name: Ditto V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: V Transformation
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may choose a Basic Pokémon V from your discard pile and switch it with this Pokémon. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.

attacks.name: Stick On
attacks.text: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ditto VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Max Transform
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

cards.name: Dubwool V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Soft Wool
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Revenge Blast
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

cards.name: Eternatus V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Power Accelerator
attacks.text: You may attach a Darkness Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dynamax Cannon
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon VMAX, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.name: Eternatus VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Eternal Zone
abilities.text: If all of your Pokémon in play are Darkness type, you can have up to 8 Pokémon on your Bench, and you can't put non-Darkness Pokémon into play. (If this Ability stops working, discard Pokémon from your Bench until you have 5.)

attacks.name: Dread End
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Darkness Pokémon in play.

cards.name: Bellsprout

attacks.name: Venoshock
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Poisoned, this attack does 40 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

cards.name: Weepinbell

abilities.name: Dangerous Mucus
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may make your opponent's Active Pokémon Burned and Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

cards.name: Victreebel

attacks.name: Panic Vine
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.flavorText: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.flavorText: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Cacturne

attacks.name: Pull
attacks.text: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiny Punch
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any Darkness Energy attached, this attack does 70 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

cards.name: Kricketune V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Exciting Stage
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may draw cards until you have 3 cards in your hand. If this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw cards until you have 4 cards in your hand instead. You can't use more than 1 Exciting Stage Ability each turn.

attacks.name: X-Scissor
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.flavorText: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

cards.name: Cherrim

abilities.name: Spring Bloom
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may attach a Grass Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes).

cards.flavorText: The faint scent that emanates from its full blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Big Bite
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Triple Whip
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Durant

attacks.name: Devour
attacks.text: For each of your Durant in play, discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

cards.name: Scatterbug

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

cards.name: Spewpa

attacks.name: Grass Cocooning
attacks.text: Heal 40 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

cards.name: Vivillon

attacks.name: Vital Powder
attacks.text: Heal all damage from 2 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

cards.name: Fomantis

attacks.name: Continuous Slash
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

cards.name: Lurantis

attacks.name: Leaf Drain
attacks.text: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

cards.name: Tapu Bulu

attacks.name: Push Down
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Nature's Judgment
attacks.text: You may discard all Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

cards.name: Blipbug
cards.flavorText: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

cards.name: Flapple V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Sour Spit
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks cost ColorlessColorless more.

cards.name: Flapple VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Rolling
attacks.text: This attack does 10 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.name: Entei

attacks.name: Heat Dash
attacks.text: You may attach a Fire Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fire Fang
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Victini V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: V Bullet
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V, this attack does 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Flare Shot
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.name: Victini VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spreading Flames
attacks.text: Attach up to 3 Fire Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Max Victory
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.flavorText: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.flavorText: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Emboar

abilities.name: Fighting Fury Stance
abilities.text: Your Single Strike Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

cards.name: Heatmor

attacks.name: Burning Licks
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

cards.name: Salandit

attacks.name: Call Sign
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

cards.name: Salazzle

attacks.name: Perplex
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Derisive Roasting
attacks.text: This attack does 90 damage for each Special Condition affecting your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

cards.name: Sizzlipede

attacks.name: Searing Flame
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

cards.name: Centiskorch

abilities.name: Overheater
abilities.text: Whenever your opponent flips a coin for their Burned Pokémon during Pokémon Checkup, it doesn't recover from that Special Condition even if the result is heads.

attacks.name: Bursting Inferno
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

cards.name: Horsea

attacks.name: Smokescreen
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

cards.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.flavorText: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Kingdra

abilities.name: Deep Sea King
abilities.text: When your Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may move any amount of Water Energy from that Pokémon to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Aqua Burst
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage for each Water Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Mime

attacks.name: Find It
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Rime

attacks.name: Ball Juggling
attacks.text: Discard any number of Item cards that have the word "Ball" in their name from your hand. This attack does 40 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.flavorText: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

cards.name: Octillery

abilities.name: Rapid Strike Search
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Rapid Strike card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Rapid Strike Search Ability each turn.

cards.flavorText: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Corphish

attacks.name: Bubble Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

cards.name: Crawdaunt

attacks.name: Knock Off
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

cards.name: Empoleon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Emperor's Eyes
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Basic Pokémon in play have no Abilities, except for Pokémon with a Rule Box (Pokémon V, Pokémon-GX, etc. have Rule Boxes).

attacks.name: Swirling Slice
attacks.text: Move an Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Frillish

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon and heal all damage from it.

cards.flavorText: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

cards.name: Jellicent

attacks.name: Sediment Sink
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each Water Energy card in your discard pile.

cards.flavorText: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.flavorText: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

cards.name: Electabuzz

attacks.name: Haymaker
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Haymaker.

cards.flavorText: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

cards.name: Electivire

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Lightning Slam
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Lightning Slam.

cards.flavorText: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.flavorText: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio

attacks.name: Jumping Kick
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray

attacks.name: Electrostep
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Scar Strikes
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Tapu Koko V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spiral Thunder
attacks.text: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Tapu Koko VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Max Shock
attacks.text: If you have more Prize cards remaining than your opponent, their Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.name: Yamper

abilities.name: Ball Search
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may put a Poké Ball card, a Great Ball card, or 1 of each from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.flavorText: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

cards.name: Boltund

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Defiant Spark
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack can be used for Lightning.

cards.flavorText: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

cards.name: Galarian Slowpoke

attacks.name: Tantailizing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.flavorText: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

cards.name: Grumpig

attacks.name: Dazzle Dance
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

cards.name: Baltoy

attacks.name: Self-Destruct
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

cards.name: Claydol

attacks.name: Power Split
attacks.text: Attach Psychic Energy cards from your discard pile to your Pokémon in any way you like until your Pokémon and your opponent's Pokémon have the same total amount of Energy attached.

cards.flavorText: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

cards.name: Chimecho

attacks.name: Minor Errand-Running
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Pleasant Tone
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Espurr

attacks.name: Focused Wish
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

cards.name: Meowstic

abilities.name: Ear Moves
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

cards.name: Mimikyu V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Dummy Doll
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may prevent all damage done to this Mimikyu V by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Jealous Eyes
attacks.text: Put 3 damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

cards.name: Necrozma V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Prismatic Ray
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Dottler

attacks.name: Radar
attacks.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

cards.flavorText: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

cards.name: Orbeetle

attacks.name: Evomancy
attacks.text: For each Energy attached to this Pokémon, search your deck for a Stage 2 Pokémon, except Orbeetle, and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

cards.name: Mankey

attacks.name: Focus Fist
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

cards.name: Primeape

attacks.name: Field Crush
attacks.text: If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Steamin' Mad Strike
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.flavorText: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

cards.name: Onix

attacks.name: Rocky Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.flavorText: It wears its mother's skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it's clear that it's always crying.

cards.name: Marowak

abilities.name: Battle Armor
abilities.text: This Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Bonemerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.flavorText: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Gliscor

attacks.name: Acrobatics
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 40 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.flavorText: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.flavorText: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

cards.name: Conkeldurr

attacks.name: Hammer Pressure
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

cards.name: Mienfoo

attacks.name: Double Stab
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

cards.name: Mienshao

attacks.name: Spinning Whip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

cards.flavorText: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

cards.name: Rolycoly

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

cards.name: Carkol

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Coalossal

attacks.name: Coal Cannon
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

cards.name: Silicobra
cards.flavorText: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

cards.name: Sandaconda

attacks.name: Big Sand Cannon
attacks.text: Discard the top 6 cards of your deck. This attack does 60 damage for each Fighting Energy card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

cards.name: Falinks

attacks.name: Rapid Strike Squad
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage for each of your Rapid Strike Pokémon in play.

cards.flavorText: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

cards.name: Stonjourner

attacks.name: Land's Pulse
attacks.text: If a Stadium is in play, this attack does 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Giga Hammer
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Giga Hammer.

cards.flavorText: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Impact Blow.

rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: G-Max Rapid Flow
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Zubat

attacks.name: Hide in Shadows
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

cards.name: Golbat

abilities.name: Discreet Draw
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Air Slash
attacks.text: Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in one go. They have been known to drink so much blood that they can no longer fly.

cards.name: Crobat

abilities.name: Drastic Draw
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may draw 3 cards.

cards.flavorText: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can't drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

cards.name: Galarian Slowbro

attacks.name: Splattering Poison
attacks.text: Both Active Pokémon are now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Unhinged Hammer
attacks.text: If this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.flavorText: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

cards.name: Murkrow

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

cards.flavorText: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

cards.name: Honchkrow

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.text: This Pokémon can't be Asleep.

attacks.name: Voltage Dive
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any Special Energy attached, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.flavorText: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

cards.name: Houndoom

abilities.name: Single Strike Roar
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Single Strike Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Single Strike Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to a Pokémon in this way, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

cards.name: Tyranitar V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Cragalanche
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Single Strike Crush
attacks.text: Discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

cards.name: Morpeko

attacks.name: Gather Food
attacks.text: Put an Item card from your discard pile into your hand.

attacks.name: Hangry Tackle
attacks.text: If you have no cards in your hand, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

cards.name: Steelix

attacks.name: Steel Swing
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 80 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

cards.name: Mawile

attacks.name: Powerful Vise
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Piercing Strike
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.flavorText: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.

cards.name: Bronzong

abilities.name: Metal Transfer
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move a Metal Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

cards.name: Pawniard

attacks.name: Swords Dance
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Slash attack does 70 more damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

cards.name: Bisharp

attacks.name: Steel Slice
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Metal Pokémon, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

cards.name: Honedge

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

cards.name: Doublade

attacks.name: Cut Down
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

cards.name: Aegislash

abilities.name: Stance Change
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch this Pokémon with an Aegislash in your hand. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.

attacks.name: Full Metal Blade
attacks.text: Discard 2 Metal Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

cards.name: Aegislash

abilities.name: Stance Change
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may switch this Pokémon with an Aegislash in your hand. Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gigaton Bash

cards.flavorText: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Sky Hurricane

cards.name: Corviknight VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's Pokémon's Abilities done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: G-Max Hurricane
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use G-Max Hurricane.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.flavorText: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.flavorText: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.flavorText: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is…questionable.

cards.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Selickt
attacks.text: Your opponent chooses to discard the top 3 cards of their deck or to discard 3 cards from their hand.

attacks.name: Pitch
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.flavorText: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

cards.name: Purugly

attacks.name: Caturday
attacks.text: Draw 3 cards. If you do, this Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

cards.name: Stoutland V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Double Dip Fangs
attacks.text: If your opponent's Basic Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from this attack, take 1 more Prize card.

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.name: Bouffalant

abilities.name: Sap Sipper
abilities.text: This Pokémon's attacks do 60 more damage to your opponent's Grass Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Head Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

cards.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Spiral Rush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Indeedee

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Hand Kinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each card in your hand.
