cards.name: Avalugg

attacks.name: Frost Barrier
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.

cards.name: Wishiwashi

abilities.name: Group Power
abilities.text: If this Pokémon has 3 or more Water Energy attached, it gets +150 HP.

attacks.name: Schooling Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each basic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.

cards.name: Eiscue

attacks.name: Blockface
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from Basic Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.

cards.name: Arctovish V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Ancient Freeze
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Pokémon V or a Pokémon-GX, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Energize
attacks.text: Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Big Sparking
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to each Pokémon V and Pokémon-GX (both yours and your opponent's). (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Thunderbolt
attacks.text: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.

cards.name: Jolteon VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Max Thunder Rumble
attacks.text: This attack also does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.flavorText: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

cards.name: Lanturn

attacks.name: Blinding Beam
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if the Defending Pokémon tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack doesn't happen.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.flavorText: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

cards.name: Flaaffy

abilities.name: Dynamotor
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Ampharos

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Electron Crush
attacks.text: You may discard 3 Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

cards.name: Emolga

attacks.name: Thunder Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.

cards.name: Dracozolt V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Primeval Beak
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, Energy cards can't be attached from your opponent's hand to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Mountain Swing
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck.

cards.name: Dracozolt VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Spark Trap
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, if this Pokémon is damaged by an attack (even if it is Knocked Out), put 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Regieleki

attacks.name: Teraspark
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack also does 40 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.flavorText: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

cards.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Hypnosis
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Wake-Up Slap
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 90 more damage. Then, that Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.

cards.flavorText: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

cards.name: Galarian Articuno

abilities.name: Cruel Charge
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Psychic Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psylaser
attacks.text: Discard all Psychic Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.

cards.name: Espeon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Zen Shot
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon V. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Espeon VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Solar Revelation
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon that have Energy attached.(Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.)

attacks.name: Max Mindstorm
attacks.text: This attack does 60 damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.

cards.name: Wobbuffet

attacks.name: Mirror Pain
attacks.text: Put damage counters on your opponent's Active Pokémon equal to the number of damage counters on 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Go and Collect
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.flavorText: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.

cards.name: Woobat

attacks.name: Collect
attacks.text: Draw a card.

cards.flavorText: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Swoobat

attacks.name: Synchro Woofer
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

cards.name: Golurk V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Rewind Beam
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an evolved Pokémon, devolve it by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Flabébé

attacks.name: Hypnotic Gaze
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

cards.name: Floette

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

cards.name: Florges

abilities.name: Rapid Strike Connection
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn, you may move an Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your Rapid Strike Pokémon.

attacks.name: Wonder Shine
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

cards.name: Sylveon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Dream Gift
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for an Item card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.

cards.name: Sylveon VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Precious Touch
attacks.text: Attach an Energy card from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, heal 120 damage from that Pokémon.

attacks.name: Max Harmony
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each different type of Pokémon on your Bench.

cards.name: Pumpkaboo

abilities.name: Pumpkin Pit
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may discard a Stadium in play.

cards.flavorText: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

cards.name: Gourgeist

attacks.name: Pandemonium
attacks.text: Reveal the top 6 cards of your deck. This attack does 60 damage for each Psychic Pokémon you find there. Then, shuffle those Pokémon back into your deck and discard the other cards.

cards.flavorText: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.flavorText: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

cards.name: Ribombee

attacks.name: Tricky Steps
attacks.text: You may move an Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon to 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.

cards.name: Marshadow

attacks.name: Rapid Hunt
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Rapid Strike cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Shadow Flicker
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Knocked Out during your next turn, take 1 more Prize card.

cards.flavorText: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.

cards.name: Hitmonchan

attacks.name: Clean Hit
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 50 more damage.

attacks.name: Bullet Straight Punch
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Galarian Zapdos

abilities.name: Strong Legs Charge
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Fighting Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Zapper Kick
attacks.text: You may discard all Energy from this Pokémon. If you do, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.

cards.name: Medicham V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Yoga Loop
attacks.text: Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by this attack, take another turn after this one. (Skip Pokémon Checkup.) If 1 of your Pokémon used Yoga Loop during your last turn, this attack can't be used.

attacks.name: Smash Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into the sand.

cards.name: Hippowdon

attacks.name: Sand Press
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.

cards.name: Roggenrola
cards.flavorText: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

cards.name: Boldore

attacks.name: Protect
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.

cards.name: Gigalith

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Pressure Shot
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself for each damage counter on it.

cards.flavorText: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.flavorText: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

cards.name: Seismitoad

attacks.name: Shaky Wave
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks cost Colorless more, and its Retreat Cost is Colorless more.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

cards.name: Lycanroc V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Crashing Fangs
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.

cards.name: Lycanroc VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Hunting Claw
attacks.text: Knock Out 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in play that has 60 HP or less remaining.

attacks.name: Max Edge
attacks.text: This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Galarian Moltres

abilities.name: Malevolent Charge
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may attach up to 2 Darkness Energy cards from your hand to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fiery Wrath
attacks.text: This attack does 50 more damage for each Prize card your opponent has taken.

cards.flavorText: The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.

cards.name: Umbreon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Mean Look
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

attacks.name: Moonlight Blade
attacks.text: If this Pokémon has any damage counters on it, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.name: Umbreon VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Dark Signal
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Nuzleaf

attacks.name: Fake Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.

cards.name: Shiftry

attacks.name: Shiftadieu
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has any damage counters on it, put it and all attached cards into your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Nipping Cyclone
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.

cards.name: Scraggy

attacks.name: Hard Head
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 10 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.

cards.name: Scrafty

attacks.name: Shakedown
attacks.text: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.

cards.name: Garbodor V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Trash Stench
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.name: Garbodor VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Rubbish Collecting
abilities.text: This Pokémon may have up to 2 Pokémon Tools attached to it. If it loses this Ability, discard Pokémon Tools from it until only 1 remains.

attacks.name: G-Max Malodor
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned. During your opponent's next turn, that Pokémon can't retreat.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.flavorText: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.

cards.name: Zoroark

abilities.name: Phantom Transformation
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may choose a Stage 1 Pokémon, except any Zoroark, from your discard pile. If you do, discard this Pokémon and all attached cards, and put the chosen Pokémon in its place.

cards.flavorText: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.flavorText: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.

cards.name: Thievul

abilities.name: Fumbling Hands
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon during your turn, you may have each player shuffle their hand and put it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws 4 cards.

cards.flavorText: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.

cards.name: Altaria

abilities.name: Tempting Tune
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, shuffle your deck, then put that card on top of it.

cards.flavorText: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

cards.name: Bagon
cards.flavorText: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.

cards.name: Shelgon

attacks.name: Hard Roll
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.

cards.name: Salamence

abilities.name: Intimidating Roar
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may have your opponent switch their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fierce Dragon
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart's desire—wings.

cards.name: Rayquaza V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Dragon Pulse
attacks.text: Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.

attacks.name: Spiral Burst
attacks.text: You may discard up to 2 basic Fire Energy or up to 2 basic Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 80 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.name: Rayquaza VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Azure Pulse
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Max Burst
attacks.text: You may discard any amount of basic Fire Energy or any amount of basic Lightning Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 80 more damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.name: Dialga

attacks.name: Chrono Wind
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Pokémon V, it can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Deino

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.flavorText: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

cards.name: Hydreigon

attacks.name: Dragon Counter
attacks.text: This attack does 100 more damage for each Prize card your opponent took during their last turn.

cards.flavorText: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.

cards.name: Kyurem

attacks.name: Extreme Freeze
attacks.text: Discard any amount of Water Energy from your Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage for each card you discarded in this way.

cards.flavorText: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

cards.name: Noivern V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Boomburst
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Synchro Loud
attacks.text: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 120 more damage.

cards.name: Zygarde

attacks.name: Judgment Surge
attacks.text: This attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon for each Prize card your opponent has taken. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

cards.name: Drampa

attacks.name: Berserk
attacks.text: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Flapple

attacks.name: Acidic Mucus
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage for each of your opponent's Pokémon in play that has an Ability.

attacks.name: Fighting Tackle
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

cards.name: Appletun

attacks.name: Thick Mucus
attacks.text: This attack does 70 damage for each Special Energy card attached to your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Fighting Tackle
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon V, this attack does 80 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

cards.name: Duraludon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

attacks.name: Breaking Swipe
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Duraludon VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Skyscraper
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon that have Special Energy attached.

attacks.name: G-Max Pulverization
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

cards.name: Regidrago

attacks.name: Dragon Energy
attacks.text: This attack does 20 less damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.

cards.name: Eevee

attacks.name: Vee-Search
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon V, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.flavorText: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.flavorText: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

cards.name: Smeargle

attacks.name: Live Painting
attacks.text: Reveal any number of basic Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy you revealed in this way.

cards.flavorText: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

cards.name: Slakoth

attacks.name: Smack 'n' Slack
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.

cards.name: Vigoroth

attacks.name: Shatter
attacks.text: Discard a Stadium in play.

cards.flavorText: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

cards.name: Slaking

abilities.name: Act Freely
abilities.text: If a Stadium is in play, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Rout
attacks.text: This attack does 30 more damage for each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

cards.name: Swablu

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

cards.name: Lillipup

attacks.name: Lead
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.

cards.name: Herdier

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.

cards.name: Stoutland

abilities.name: Intimidating Fang
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks do 30 less damage (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Knock Away
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 100 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.

cards.name: Rufflet

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: A combative Pokémon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.

cards.name: Braviary

attacks.name: Valiant Talons
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is an Evolution Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Brave Bird
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 50 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.

cards.name: Fletchling

attacks.name: Tailwind Draw
attacks.text: Draw a card. If you go second and it's your first turn, draw 3 more cards.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack

cards.name: Rowlet

cards.name: Grookey
cards.flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Charmander

cards.name: Cyndaquil
cards.flavorText: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

cards.name: Torchic

cards.name: Chimchar

cards.name: Tepig

cards.name: Fennekin

cards.name: Scorbunny

attacks.name: Super Singe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.

cards.flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

cards.name: Squirtle

attacks.name: Bubble
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Totodile

attacks.name: Fury Strikes
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.name: Mudkip
cards.flavorText: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.flavorText: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

cards.name: Oshawott

attacks.name: Water Pulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.flavorText: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Popplio
cards.flavorText: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

cards.name: Sobble

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

cards.name: Pikachu

attacks.name: Meal Time

cards.flavorText: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Ho-Oh

attacks.name: Fire Blast

cards.flavorText: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.

attacks.name: Black Flame

cards.flavorText: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

cards.name: Kyogre

cards.name: Palkia

cards.name: Cosmoem

attacks.name: Star Protection
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks.

cards.flavorText: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.
